ov: Small rodents best known through the house mouse, which lives alongside people almost everywhere. It was domesticated as the pet “fancy mouse” and as the laboratory mouse, one of biology’s most important model animals.

why.ac: Mostly crepuscular or nocturnal; mice avoid bright light.
why.p: The fancy mouse, a domesticated house mouse, is a common pet, though less popular than some other rodents.

rg: Worldwide alongside people. The house mouse’s subspecies come from southern Asia and western Europe.

cf.tip: Mice and rats are told apart mainly by size: “rat” is used for the bigger kinds, “mouse” for the smaller.
